title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, templates, and docs site updates
author: Asha Verma
description: Motivation: provide concrete, production-oriented quickstarts for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents that demonstrate tool-calling patterns, templates, and recommended configuration for both Python and TypeScript users. This PR adds opinionated templates, runnable examples, smoke tests, and docs-site updates so customers and internal engineers can get started quickly and safely. Changes include: - new quickstart templates for RAG agents (playbook + runtime config) - tool-calling examples in Python and TypeScript showing API usage, tool registration, and structured output parsing - docs guide describing trade-offs (batching, caching, model variants) + recommended rollout steps - docs site sidebar/nav updates and a new landing page for agent quickstarts - smoke/integration tests to validate examples on CI - a small refactor to examples loader to support template variables Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Add docs guide and sidebar entries - [x] Add smoke tests and CI job - [x] Address reviewer feedback - [x] Update changelog/release notes Related: Linear ENG-1983 (RAG agent quickstarts), DOC-412 (docs site layout). Diff is intentionally small per file (examples + docs + tests). See changed_files for details.
